KeyHelm

Accessibility

Effective 2026-10-20

We want everyone to be able to use KeyHelm, including people who use screen readers, keyboard navigation, zoom or other assistive technology.

What we do

  • We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA.
  • Pages work with a keyboard, show a visible focus outline, use real labels on form fields, and support your device's light or dark setting and reduced-motion setting.
  • We check text and button colors for readable contrast.

Known limits

We are a small team and have not yet had an independent accessibility audit. Some parts of the service may not work well with every assistive technology yet.

Tell us about a problem

If something is hard to use, email help@keyhelm.example and tell us the page and what happened. We will reply within 5 business days and help you get what you need another way in the meantime.
